Karnataka Pitches for Toyota Expansion at Global Investors Meet

Karnataka has invited investments from Toyota Motor Corporation, with the delegation led by Chairman, Managing Director, and CEO Masakazu Yoshimura, at a Global Investors Meet. The state government assured support for Toyota's expansion to a one million capacity. Chief Minister Shivakumar also proposed adopting Japan's affordable hybrid taxi model for the state.
